frames.caption: Current HospitalSim Overview: the supplied screenshot shows the persisted demo baseline, with 4 patients, 3 staff, and 2 hospitals.
The sidebar opens Patients, Staff, Roles, Hospitals, and Testing. Clicking an item scrolls the page to the top.
The metrics show 4 patient records, 3 assigned to care, 3 staff, and 2 hospitals with a combined capacity of 12 patients.
Care assignments group actual patient records by clinician. The baseline assigns one patient each to Olivia, Noah, and Mia.
Open Testing leads to the Populate and Test actions. Their request and SQL previews require confirmation before database writes.
The patient registry shows profile icons, names, birth dates, hospital, and assigned staff. Manage patients opens the CRUD directory.
The connection box sits above the local profile. Dark mode follows the browser by default; the visible switch saves a manual override.
Documentation and Swagger stay in the header. Dashboard and Swagger links require a running local FastAPI and MySQL instance.
This is a guided camera tour of one supplied screenshot. No browser clicks, CRUD operations, or running test are recorded in this clip.
